verdict.rationale: A training-data opt-out is a fair axis for an AI coding workbench, but the evidence pack never mentions a model-training policy, privacy setting, or opt-out control for code and prompts. Community reports about workspace uploads describe data transfer, not a training opt-out, and there is no vendor claim for them to contradict. Absence of evidence for an applicable capability yields none.

support.subject: As an engineering-lead, I can opt out of having my code and prompts used for AI model training
